rust_summary: living-entity helpers for fighters and NPCs: a mob's swing (`native_entity_swing`), setting how long an entity burns (`native_entity_set_fire`), a mob's status effects (`native_entity_effects`), a mob's attribute base (`native_entity_set_attribute_base`), a mob's item-use pose (`native_entity_use_item`), and a lightning bolt that can be visual only (`native_lightning_bolt`).
doc_summary: `entity.swing(host, off_hand)` swings a mob's arm (`LivingEntity.swing`, the off hand when `off_hand`; players send their own swing, so it is `false` for them); `entity.set_fire(host, ticks)` sets how many ticks it burns (`setRemainingFireTicks`, 0 puts it out; players acting and mobs); `entity.effects(host)` lists a mob's status effects as (id, ticks left, amplifier) (players: `effects` by UUID); `entity.set_attribute_base(host, attribute, base)` sets a mob's attribute base (`max_health`, `minecraft:max_health`...); `entity.use_item(host, off_hand, using)` sets the item-use pose a shield shows without the mob's own use running; `lightning_bolt(dimension, pos, visual_only)` strikes lightning in a loaded level, with fire and damage only unless `visual_only`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:living_helpers@.
